description: [Superseded] Flood Study — Cabbage Tree Creek — Jun 2014 is a dataset listed in Brisbane City Council open data portal (data.brisbane.qld.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. [Superseded Nov 2019] Brisbane City Council Cabbage Tree Creek Flood Study. This dataset contains reports, data and metadata used in the flood study for the existing and ultimate floodplain condition scenarios. Council is committed to ensuring we have the latest flood modelling data to help manage flood risk in Brisbane. Coverage: Brisbane, Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Brisbane City Council. Its tags are catchment, creek, flood, flood map, flood study. It offers 3 resource(s) in csv, json. The portal shows 2024-09-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
